args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the latest deploy of v2.3.1 (error rate 0.18, unhealthy in all regions: us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back to the most recent release that was healthy in production, v2.3.0, in all regions. Rollback verified as rolled_out. Monitoring continues; investigating root cause of v2.3.1 regression.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

## Actions Taken

1. **Investigated** checkout-api status and deployment history:
   - Current version **v2.3.1** was unhealthy in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of 0.18.
   - Deployment history showed v2.3.1 (seq 3) as the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (seq 1).

2. **Rolled back** checkout-api to **v2.3.0** in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). The rollback was verified as `rolled_out`.

3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) for checkout-api describing the failure and the rollback, which paged the on-call engineer.

## Notes
- The rollback target v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).
- The unhealthy v2.3.1-rc in staging was not a candidate since it was never healthy in production.
- No change-manager approval was needed since this was a rollback to a previously healthy production version, not a new deploy.
